baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction joins `أقسم`, `رب`, the paired plurals `المشارق والمغارب`, and emphatic `إنا لقادرون`.
baseline_models.mechanism: A binding oath invokes ownership of every recurring rise and setting as evidence for effective control. The paired plural horizons bracket the whole field of appearance and disappearance, so capability is warranted by comprehensive lordship rather than asserted as bare force.

activation_trace.role: The oath-taking branch supplies the binding speech act that warrants the capability claim.
Lordship, ownership, and authority make the plural horizons a governed domain.
Rising light supplies the repeated appearance-side of the encompassing horizon pair.
Sunset and west supply the repeated disappearance-side that completes the bracket.
Effective capacity and mastery turn ownership of the horizon field into ability to act within it.

changed_reading.before: A solemn cosmic oath followed by a general assertion of power.
changed_reading.after: The oath argues from comprehensive governance: the One who owns every recurrence of appearing and vanishing possesses effective control over what crosses those bounds.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same sequence permits `أقسم` to retain its oath sense while the root's apportionment branch resonates with plural risings, plural settings, and `قادرون`.
baseline_models.mechanism: The oath is shadowed by division into shares: recurring risings and settings partition a continuum into administered phases. Stage-by-stage nurture and measured arrangement make power look calibrated, distributing emergence and recession according to bounds rather than merely overwhelming them.

activation_trace.role: Apportioning a thing into shares supplies a distributive undertone beneath the explicit oath.
Nurture and completion stage by stage supply the process that administers successive horizon phases.
Rising light marks the opening phase of each apportioned cycle.
Setting marks the closing bound paired with each opening.
Measure reaching a thing's extent makes the plurality a set of bounded, calibrated portions.
Arrangement by estimate supplies deliberate sequencing rather than an accidental cycle.

changed_reading.before: Power is inferred from possession of many geographic east and west points.
changed_reading.after: Power is also administrative precision: every emergence and recession is allotted, nurtured through stages, and brought to its measured bound.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is framed by measured creation from material known to the addressees and by one thing being put in another's place. This narrows `لقادرون` from unrestricted power to unpreventable re-composition: the Lord who measures the horizon cycle can replace a present cohort with a better-formed one and cannot be outrun in doing so.

activation_trace.role: Creation as measuring and proportioning supplies a constructive operation immediately before the focus.
Disclosure to a knower makes the created material an acknowledged datum rather than an abstract premise.
One thing standing in another's place specifies substitution as the action governed by `قادرون`.
Superior fitness and selection give the replacement a comparative direction rather than mere exchange.
Failure to escape a pursuer supplies the negative limit: no subject can get beyond the replacing power.
The oath binds the flanking creation and substitution claims into an assurance.
Deliberate preparation and proportioning connect focus capability to re-forming rather than brute removal.

structural_cues: 70:39 precedes the focus and 70:41 grammatically completes `لقادرون على أن نبدل`, making 70:40 a hinge between making and replacement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation, known material, substitution, comparative betterment, and non-escape; I infer the arrow creation -> re-proportioning -> replacement. A live alternative is that the frame proves general power without specifying a constructive mode.

changed_reading.before: The horizon oath supports an unspecified claim of omnipotence.
changed_reading.after: The oath guarantees a particular operation: known created material can be re-proportioned into a better substitute, and that operation cannot be outpaced.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ascent, a day measured at an immense duration, and the reversal of far versus near convert the plural horizons from fixed map points into scale-relative thresholds. What rises or sets, and how long its passage is, depends on the observer's measure; divine capability governs the conversion among those scales.

activation_trace.role: Ascent to a higher level supplies vertical passage across, rather than residence at, a horizon.
A duration of time lets one named day stretch beyond an ordinary daylight interval.
Measured extent explicitly makes the ascent's duration a scale rather than a vague delay.
Distance from nearness supplies the human assessment of the event's remoteness.
Nearness reverses that assessment and proves that distance is viewpoint-dependent.
Plural risings become repeated passage thresholds across changing frames.
Plural settings complete the frame-relative trajectories.
Effective control assigns divine capability over the measures whose mismatch produces far and near.

structural_cues: 70:3-7 sequences plural ascent routes, an immense measured day, human `far`, and divine `near` before the focus reintroduces plural horizon points.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ascent, duration, numerical measure, and a far/near reversal; I infer that multiple risings and settings encode observer- and scale-relative thresholds. The live alternative is ordinary cosmological merism with the temporal material serving only as separate context.

changed_reading.before: The plurals denote many geographic or seasonal sunrise and sunset points.
changed_reading.after: The plurals also register multiple frames of passage: the Lord controls horizons whose distance and duration change with scale, making the apparently far event near.

context_deltas.mechanism: A known right moves from wealth toward both requester and deprived person, while covenant and testimony preserve accountable claims. This activates the apportionment branch inside the root of `أقسم`: without canceling the verb's oath grammar, the oath now carries a juridical shadow in which shares are identified, witnessed, and delivered under the Lord's measured authority.

activation_trace.role: Possessed wealth supplies the divisible domain from which an allotted claim can move.
A specific right owned by its holder turns distribution into satisfaction of a claim, not discretionary generosity.
Known disclosure makes the due share determinate and inspectable.
Request and asking identify one claimant who voices the need.
Deprivation and loss of the sought thing identify a claimant whose lack may remain unvoiced.
A preserved covenant supplies the durable obligation that protects assigned claims.
Declaration grounded in knowledge supplies the public evidentiary act alongside the oath.
Apportioning into shares is the focus-root image activated by the context's known right.
The oath branch preserves the actual verbal construction while linking it to accountable testimony.
Measured extent gives each due portion a bounded amount.

structural_cues: 70:24-25 moves from a known right in possessions to two differently positioned claimants; 70:32-33 later pairs covenant care with standing testimony.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wealth, an owned right, knownness, voiced and unvoiced need, covenant, and testimony; I infer that q-s-m's oath and share branches illuminate one another. The live alternative keeps `أقسم` purely as oath and treats distribution as an unrelated ethical sequence.

changed_reading.before: `أقسم` functions only as emphatic speech introducing cosmic evidence.
changed_reading.after: The oath remains an oath but also resonates with measured allotment: the Lord of all horizons guarantees an order in which due shares and claimants are known, witnessed, and not lost.

context_deltas.mechanism: The crowd approaches and arranges itself at the right and left of one local center while each person hopes for entry into a screened garden. The focus replaces that narrow bilateral map with plural risings and settings; together with apportionment and subsequent substitution, capability becomes power to redraw positions and reassign privileged occupancy.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face orientation establishes the human center around which the crowd places itself.
Rushing forward makes the arrangement an active claim on proximity rather than a static diagram.
The right hand and rightward side supply one pole of the crowd's local sorting axis.
The left or north side supplies the opposite pole of that bilateral axis.
Hopeful desire explains why each individual treats position as a claim to admission.
The tree-screened garden supplies the bounded privileged interior being claimed.
Substitution authorizes reassignment of occupants after the focus expands the coordinate frame.
Apportionment supplies the mechanism by which positions and shares can be redistributed.
Plural risings multiply the available orientation points beyond the crowd's single right-left axis.
Plural settings complete the expanded field and deny that either local side exhausts it.
Effective mastery gives the Lord power to redraw the field and enact its reassignment.

structural_cues: 70:36-38 depicts people in separated groups around a human-facing right-left axis; 70:40 abruptly pluralizes both cosmic directions before 70:41 names replacement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies approach, bilateral placement, desired admission, plural horizons, and substitution; I infer an arrow from self-positioning -> de-centering -> redistribution. A live alternative reads right/left as incidental crowd description and the horizons only as a conventional cosmic oath.

changed_reading.before: The easts and wests merely enlarge the geographical scope of the oath.
changed_reading.after: The plural horizons de-center the crowd's self-assigned right and left: divine capability can redraw the coordinate field and redistribute who occupies its favored interior.

context_deltas.mechanism: An appointed time gives way to rapid exit from graves toward an erected marker. This activates rising and setting as a grammar of controlled egress and destination: capability over the horizons includes scheduling when concealed bodies cross outward and where their motion terminates.

activation_trace.role: An appointment fixed by time or place supplies the procession's schedule.
Passage to the outside supplies the human analogue to a rising emergence.
The grave supplies the concealed enclosure from which the outward crossing begins.
Speed opposed to slowness turns emergence into a coordinated rush.
An erected boundary or marker supplies a visible terminus toward which the released bodies move.
Rising light supplies the focus-side image of emergence from concealment.
Setting supplies the paired crossing out of visibility that makes emergence reversible.
Planned arrangement assigns timing and destination to the procession.

structural_cues: 70:42-44 moves from the promised day to grave-egress, rapid goalward motion, and humbled arrival.
The branchless 70:43 `يوفضون` is used only as a structural acceleration cue and is not branch-cited.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointment, exit, graves, speed, and an erected destination; I infer that the solar horizon pair can analogically organize human concealment and re-emergence. The live alternative is a direct resurrection proof with no aperture or procession model.

changed_reading.before: Recurring sunrise and sunset serve as remote cosmic evidence of power.
changed_reading.after: The horizons become a process model for an appointed human crossing: concealment, timed egress, rapid transit, and arrival all remain under measured control.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers a color-and-time branch of sh-f-q into the affective use `مشفقون`; it remains anchored by the same context root beside `رب` and by focus `المغارب`. Render only as a twilight-affect resonance, not as a claim that the context word lexically means sunset.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: `رب المغارب` can receive an affective coloration from `مشفقون من عذاب ربهم` because sh-f-q carries both red twilight and care mixed with fear.

activation_trace.role: The red afterglow at sunset supplies the liminal visual field projected onto the focus settings.
Care mixed with fear supplies the context's vigilant affect within that twilight field.
Lordship links the feared authority in 70:27 to the owner of the settings in the focus.
Actual sunset anchors the cross-domain resonance in the focus rather than leaving it as free affect.

changed_reading.before: The settings are neutral coordinates in a cosmic merism.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, each setting is also a recurring red threshold of apprehensive care, coloring the Lord's horizon rule with the surah's vigilant fear.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it transfers guarded bodily opening and grave-egress into cosmic spatial mechanics; it remains anchored in the focus root's opening branch, ordinary sunset, and `قادرون`. Render as a material analogy for controlled thresholds, never as the lexical gloss of `المشارق والمغارب`.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening branch under sh-r-q, paired with setting and capability, permits the horizon plurals to be tested as controlled apertures rather than only directions.

activation_trace.role: An opening or gap between two things supplies the aperture image.
Guarding and watchfulness make the aperture controlled rather than freely permeable.
Passage outward demonstrates a later crossing through a boundary.
Splitting something open supplies the focus-root's unusual but explicit opening image.
Ordinary setting preserves the paired disappearance threshold and keeps the analogy tied to the surface noun.
Effective control assigns authority over when and what may cross the proposed apertures.

changed_reading.before: Easts and wests are directional points at which light appears and disappears.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, they are multiple guarded thresholds through which emergence and withdrawal are admitted under effective control.

strongest_changes: The immediate 70:39-41 frame specifies capability as measured re-creation and better substitution that cannot be outpaced.
The measured ascent and far/near reversal turn plural horizons into scale-relative thresholds, not only compass points.
The known right, claimant pair, covenant, and testimony activate an accountable apportionment undertone in the root of `أقسم` while preserving its oath grammar.
The right-left crowd scene is de-centered by plural horizons, making replacement a redistribution of claimed positions.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact chain of oath, lordship, plural boundary points, and capacity acts as a hinge. Context repeatedly changes static directions into operations: measuring, allotting, substituting, re-scaling, admitting, and bringing out.
remaining_uncertainties: The apportionment resonance is root-based and functional; it should not displace the direct oath syntax of `أقسم`.
The scale-relative horizon model is coherent but does not decide whether the plurality is primarily spatial, seasonal, temporal, or observer-indexed.
The twilight-affect and guarded-aperture readings are intentionally exploratory analogies and require explicit qualification in downstream prose.
